title: Implement message thread oversampling factor change with mute fade
description:
Extend Source/DSP/OversamplingEngine.h and Source/DSP/OversamplingEngine.cpp so that oversampling factor changes are performed on the message thread with a re-prepare and a 10 ms mute-fade, never re-allocating inside processBlock (risk_notes: oversampling re-allocation must never occur inside processBlock). Add a message-thread-side requestFactorChange/applyPendingFactor path that re-prepares the underlying Oversampling stages, and an audio-path mute-fade ramp so the transition is click-free while latency is re-reported via getLatencySamples(). Depends on the engine created in e.1. STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/OversamplingEngine.h/.cpp as created in task e.1 for the prepare and getLatencySamples surface
- JUCE/modules/juce_dsp for SmoothedValue and Oversampling re-prepare semantics (read only)
- PluginProcessor.h/.cpp (if present) for how message-thread parameter changes are dispatched
acceptance_criteria: OversamplingEngine exposes a message-thread factor-change path that re-prepares stages off the audio thread
A 10 ms mute-fade is applied on the audio path across a factor change; no re-allocation occurs inside the audio processing path
getLatencySamples() reflects the newly applied factor after a change so setLatencySamples can be re-issued
cmake --build build --target ShredBoost compiles the modified OversamplingEngine.cpp without errors
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: re-allocate or re-prepare oversampling stages inside processBlock or the audio processing path
